moduleContract: Full pinned Node22 export-name record. Both specifier aliases bind the same actual default object/functions; process global equals default. Explicit partial behavior and limitations follow.

node:process.callablePolicy: Supported finite methods use real guest algorithms/native providers. Enumerated unsupported callables throw own coded ERR_SM_NODE_UNSUPPORTED on call or construction; no host builtin adapters.
deviations: Deployed bootstrap is required before app imports; INIT captures no CLI values or host resources.

env is a mutable null-prototype guest string map. Unlike Node native env, arbitrary new assignments do not automatically stringify numbers/booleans; Next ordinary string assignments are the supported cut.

argv contains actual standard CLI arguments; no fabricated Node executable/script prefix. versions.node is the compatibility target, not a host Node engine claim. platform=wasi/arch=wasm32; pid/ppid/execPath/debugPort/stdin/report/finalization are explicitly undefined.

Process EventEmitter methods are real existing guest Events methods. Engine unhandled-rejection/uncaught-exception delivery remains the existing fatal/discard policy; registering listeners does not install Node recovery.

stdout/stderr.write is bounded synchronous UTF8/fixed-U8 with deferred nextTick callback; logical fd1/2 are not host POSIX descriptors. isTTY=false is the explicit nonterminal profile. Stream close/destroy/end and other encodings refuse.
nextTick uses the existing traced bounded InternalTickQueue with actual engine checkpoint integration; this Source does not prove new native link/runtime ordering.
All other enumerated callable exports throw own ERR_SM_NODE_UNSUPPORTED on call and construction. Full Node callable metadata/ESM live synchronization is not claimed.

process.config is undefined: no Node configure result is fabricated. Empty argv/env remain ordinary local objects before mandatory deployed bootstrap; property reads themselves do not trigger host IO or proxy traps.
